Highlights

Highlights

Multiple Convection Modes

This microwave is sure to impress with its heat and brown settings, including ConvecBroil, ConvecRoast, ConvecBake, and manual convection. It functions not only as a microwave but also as a versatile second oven.

Child Safety Lock

Prevent unwanted use and avoid action figure meltdowns with the child safety lock.

Fast Cooking Times

Cook bigger and quicker with fast cooking times. Cooking times for certain foods are actually faster than using a built-in oven.

Add-A-Minute

With one touch of a button, a minute of cooking time is added to your meal.

Convenient Presets

Preset sensor settings make cooking, reheating, and even popping popcorn effortless and precise.

Perfect Cooking

Combines convection heat with microwave energy to brown and seal the outside while thoroughly cooking the interior.
